title: Integrative Single-Cell and Bulk Transcriptomic Analysis Reveals Ribosome Biogenesis-Associated Molecular Subtypes and Immune Characteristics in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
snippet: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) exhibits substantial molecular heterogeneity. We integrated single-cell and bulk transcriptomic data to investigate associations between ribosome biogenesis-related (RiboSis-related) gene expression and the molecular and immune characteristics of HCC.
